# tests/fixtures/t0183

T-0183 group B, probe P2 (docs/tasks/T-0183.md, B2): a reading probe on a synthetic dense name list at 1568x590, the
geometry of the HUD shared-screen frame in the evidence session (`logs/sessions/20261027-235044-1453646.jsonl`, t15-t18,
where the model misread a name in a dense list at the engine's default budget of 280).

## `names.html`

- **What it is:** one static page, no script, no external resource. A 12 x 8 table of 96 distinct **invented** names
  (no real person), rows numbered 1-12 and columns lettered A-H, at 11 px, sized to 1568 x 590 CSS px. A third of the
  surnames are hyphenated, the shape of the evidence's misread name.
- **sha256:** `f8c3257fa5597cdcd2d8031c4fcff1232e74eaebdd1c25ac1a698b172c38f14c`, 3,262 bytes.

## `answer_key.json`

- **What it holds:** the page name, the viewport `[1568, 590]`, the grid size, the seed (0) and 20 questions
  (`q01`-`q20`), each "What is the name in row R, column C?" with the exact name in that cell as `answer`. P2 scores
  exact-name accuracy against `answer`.
- **sha256:** `192b65206cc96f5bb39e8bc43f8c3b1c5fef812d8c75118923236f5bb0349d94`, 2,343 bytes.

## Provenance

Generated by the test-author on 2026-10-28 with the stdlib-only script below (`python3 gen_names.py <dir>`, Python
3.11), written to the session scratchpad and copied here byte for byte (sha256 checked). Licence: the repository's
(Apache-2.0); the names are combinations of invented first names and surnames, not drawn from any dataset.

`gen_names.py` (sha256 `d2fa499c237a81d0d7102a46458c7f6338baff91847b13a9913a93b0047829da`; fenced as `text`, not
`python`, so `ruff format` leaves its bytes, and so its sha256, alone):

```text
"""Generate tests/fixtures/t0183/names.html and answer_key.json (T-0183 P2): invented names, seed 0, stdlib only."""
import json, random, sys
from pathlib import Path

FIRST = ["Ada", "Bram", "Cleo", "Dov", "Edda", "Finn", "Gita", "Hal", "Ines", "Jory", "Kael", "Lise", "Mato",
         "Nell", "Odo", "Pia", "Quin", "Rhea", "Soren", "Tova", "Ulla", "Vito", "Wren", "Yara", "Zev", "Alba",
         "Bodil", "Cyrus", "Dagny", "Emrys"]
LAST = ["Arkwright", "Bellamy-Stroud", "Corvane", "Dunleavy", "Esterhold", "Fairbank-Low", "Grimaldo",
        "Hollins-Vey", "Ivanek", "Jurado", "Kestrel-Moor", "Lindqvist", "Marrow", "Nakashima-Bell", "Oyelaran",
        "Pemberton-Ash", "Quarrie", "Rosewell", "Stavros-Lind", "Thorncastle", "Ubaldi", "Vantongeren",
        "Whitlock-Rae", "Xandry", "Yelverton", "Zabrowski", "Ashcombe-Pell", "Brightwater", "Calloway-Dunn",
        "Delacourt"]
ROWS, COLS = 12, 8
rng = random.Random(0)
seen = set()
names = []
while len(names) < ROWS * COLS:
    n = f"{rng.choice(FIRST)} {rng.choice(LAST)}"
    if n not in seen:
        seen.add(n)
        names.append(n)
grid = [names[r * COLS:(r + 1) * COLS] for r in range(ROWS)]
cells = "\n".join(
    "<tr><th>%d</th>%s</tr>" % (r + 1, "".join(f"<td>{n}</td>" for n in row)) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
)
head = "".join(f"<th>{c}</th>" for c in "ABCDEFGH")
html = f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Workshop attendees (T-0183 P2 fixture)</title>
<style>
html, body {{ margin: 0; background: #fff; color: #222; font: 11px/1.25 sans-serif; }}
body {{ width: 1568px; height: 590px; overflow: hidden; padding: 6px 10px; box-sizing: border-box; }}
h1 {{ font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 4px; }}
table {{ border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }}
th, td {{ border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 1px 4px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }}
th {{ background: #f2f2f2; font-weight: 600; }}
</style></head>
<body><h1>Workshop attendees</h1>
<table><thead><tr><th></th>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>
{cells}
</tbody></table></body></html>
"""
picks = rng.sample([(r, c) for r in range(ROWS) for c in range(COLS)], 20)
questions = [
    {"id": f"q{i + 1:02d}", "question": f"What is the name in row {r + 1}, column {'ABCDEFGH'[c]}?",
     "answer": grid[r][c]}
    for i, (r, c) in enumerate(picks)
]
key = {"page": "names.html", "viewport": [1568, 590], "rows": ROWS, "columns": COLS, "seed": 0,
       "questions": questions}
out = Path(sys.argv[1])
(out / "names.html").write_text(html)
(out / "answer_key.json").write_text(json.dumps(key, indent=1) + "\n")
```
